title: Closing, Escrow Payment and Coverage Confirmation — Real Estate Service Contracts
content:
This guidance sets out what happens to a Real Estate Service Contracts plan at and after closing, how the plan invoice is paid through escrow, and when an unclosed order ends.

## At closing

- The ordering agent or the escrow officer reports the closing with the actual closing date and the escrow file number.
- The buyer, whose customer profile must be on file, becomes the contract holder, and the coverage start date equals the closing date.
- The term end date is the day before the same calendar day the plan's buyer term (in months) later, falling back to the last day of the month when that day does not exist. *Hypothetical illustration:* a closing on 15 June under a 12-month buyer term gives a term end date of 14 June of the following year.
- Seller listing coverage ends at closing; requests the seller placed before closing are finished under seller coverage.
- The expected closing date may be changed only before closing.

## Payments and coverage confirmation

- Payments are applied to the oldest open invoice first.
- **Confirmation window.** Buyer coverage is confirmed only when the plan invoice is paid in full no later than the plan's escrow payment window, in calendar days, after the sale closes, counting from the day after the closing date with the boundary day included. The clock starts from the sale closing, as shown by the closing date on the contract record; the payment state is read from the plan's own billing record.
- Once confirmed, buyer coverage applies to failures reported from the closing date onward.
- While the contract is closed pending payment, the buyer's service requests are recorded but no contractor is dispatched.

## Voiding an unpaid plan

- **Void condition.** A plan whose invoice is still unpaid is voided once more than the plan's escrow payment window, in calendar days, has passed after the sale closes, counted from the day after the closing date.
- A voided plan's invoice is credited in full, requests recorded while it was pending are closed not covered, and a payment arriving after the void is refunded to the payer.

### Both clocks counted out (plan whose escrow payment window is 30 days; days counted from the day after the closing date)

| Day | Invoice paid in full on that day | Invoice still unpaid on that day |
|---|---|---|
| day 29 | within the confirmation window | not yet past the window; no void |
| day 30 (the boundary day) | within the confirmation window | not yet past the window; no void |
| day 31 | outside the confirmation window | more than 30 days have passed; the plan is voided |

## Orders that do not close

- A buyer-only order still in awaiting closing more than the plan's pending-order lapse period, in calendar days, after its expected closing date lapses and is cancelled by the agent.
- The agent may also cancel a listing or buyer-only order at any time before closing when the sale will not proceed.

## Status reference

| From | To | Moved by | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| listing coverage | closed pending payment | system | The sale closes; the buyer becomes the contract holder and the plan invoice awaits payment from escrow. |
| awaiting closing | closed pending payment | system | The sale closes on a buyer-only order and the plan invoice awaits payment from escrow. |
| closed pending payment | active | system | The plan invoice is paid within the escrow payment window and buyer coverage is in force from the closing date. |
| closed pending payment | voided | system | The plan invoice is not paid within the escrow payment window and the plan is voided. |
| listing coverage | listing expired | system | The seller listing period ends without a closing. |
| listing coverage | cancelled | agent | The ordering agent cancels the order because the listing was withdrawn or the sale will not proceed. |
| awaiting closing | cancelled | agent | The ordering agent cancels a buyer-only order before closing |
| active | cancelled | buyer | The buyer cancels buyer coverage during the term. |
| active | expired | system | The buyer term ends. |
| active | converted | buyer | The buyer accepts the direct renewal offer before the term ends and continues under a homeowner service contract. |
| expired | converted | buyer | The buyer accepts the direct renewal offer shortly after the term ended and continues under a homeowner service contract. |

The plan's invoice balance is the amount owed on the contract's invoices (the plan premium invoiced to escrow and any failed-sale charge billed to the seller); a negative balance means a credit owed back.
